summary: Baidu's open-source deep learning framework for training and deploying models, including large models, across many chip types.

heroCommands.command: Follow the Quick Install guide at paddlepaddle.org.cn

sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: PaddlePaddle is a deep learning framework that originated at Baidu and has been open source since 2016. It covers the core framework plus model libraries, development kits and tools. The 3.x generation unifies dynamic and static graphs with automatic parallel training, uses one framework for both training and inference of large models, adds high-order differentiation for scientific computing, includes a neural network compiler, and adapts to many hardware chip types through standard interfaces.
sixtySeconds.problem: Training and deploying big models across different hardware usually takes separate tools. PaddlePaddle aims to cover the whole flow in one framework.
whoFor: ML engineers, especially in China's ecosystem
Teams training large models across many chips
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Pick it if you use Baidu's model ecosystem or need broad support for domestic and varied AI chips.
requirements: See the official Quick Install guide for supported Python, OS and hardware

Guides, practice tutorials and an API reference are on paddlepaddle.org.cn in English and Chinese. Apache-2.0 licensed.
